newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stork wins Dfl 1 billion gasfield order.
newsitem.headline: Stork wins Dfl 1 billion gasfield order.

text.p: Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij NAM, a 50-50 Dutch joint venture between Royal Dutch/Shell and Exxon, said on Wednesday it had chosen industrial services group Stork NV to carry out renovations at its Slochteren gasfield amounting to some 1 billion guilders.

"NAM and the Stork GLT consortium...plan to undertake an agreement for the renovation, compression installation and maintenance for an initial 11 of the 29 production installations of the (northern Dutch) Slochteren gas field," NAM said in a statement.

"The contract between NAM and Stork GLT is worth over one billion guilders," NAM said. Renovation and the fitting of compression to all 29 installations will require an investment of some three billion guilders, it said.
The entire project will generate some 10,000 man-years' worth of jobs.
NAM said the contract was expected to be signed in February next year. It said it had chosen Stork GLT from entrants to a design competition.

The Stork GLT consortium comprises three Stork units -- Delaval Stork, Stork Comprimo and Stork ICM, which will design, build and install the compressors -- as well as Japanese industrial instruments maker Yokogawa and Siemens .
NAM said the renovation of its Slochteren field had become imperative because the installations were outmoded and no longer fulfilled requirements.

Reductions in pressure throughout the gasfield meant it was necessary to install a compressor at each of the production locations. The upgraded locations would be maintained by the consortium, NAM added.
Work on the first location is scheduled for completion by the winter of 1998/99, NAM said.
